reviews.text: Excellent service! We entrusted our cat Minou to Benoit for a few days, and he was impeccable. In addition to providing her with food and fresh water, he spent time playing with her at home and sent us photos and videos every day. The wonderful thing is that Minou, who is usually quite wary of strangers, immediately became friends with him. We absolutely recommend him and, if we need it, we will definitely contact him again!

I agree with all the positive reviews. Benoit and Sophia are two excellent professionals, attentive to everything and well-prepared. It was my first experience with them. I have a 6-year-old male Amstaff, so you can imagine the care they take. They are knowledgeable and attentive to everything, both on walks and at home. I highly recommend them. They are precise with their schedules and are attentive in sending videos and photos to show how happy and happy the pet is.
5 stars!!!!

Sophia and Benoit are amazing! They took care of my cat several times while I was traveling, and I've never felt more at ease thanks to all the photos and videos I've received. I immediately understood the love and passion they put into caring for animals, and Maxine and I couldn't ask for anyone better! Thank you so much ❤️

Sophie is wonderful. Our cat loves her, and we trust her implicitly. She's knowledgeable, reliable, and loving. We've been trusting her for over two years now, both long and short term. Unparalleled. 🩷🩷🩷

We were on vacation and we needed to leave our dog somewhere to go into the Vatican, and this was the perfect place. It was clear they treated him well, and the price was very good.
I recommend it 100%
Very convenient and very nice people. Excellent service, would recommend to anyone and good service for tourist that are visiting.
Our dog absolutely loves the place and had a wonderful time there. He came back for the second time with so much excitement and happiness. Highly recommended 😊 …

While I was staying in Rome, Sophia looked after my dog Baloo for a week of boarding and a few days of daycare. Upon first meeting Sophia I was immediately put at ease by her warm energy, professionalism and communicativeness. Baloo also took an immediate liking to her. Throughout his stay she provided many updates and photos and I always felt assured that he was well taken care of (and he was so excited to go back). I would definitely recommend trusting your dog with them and next time I am in Rome I will not hesitate to contact them again.

I had the absolute best experience with Benoit and Sophia and their care and love for my dog while I was visiting Rome. At first, I was very apprehensive, leaving my dog with strangers in a foreign city, but they both made me feel so much more comfortable. Especially all the photos and videos that they shared that clearly showed my dog having the best time of his life with both of them, but also with other cute dogs that they were caring for. I ended up trusting them with my dog for a number of days, including overnight stays, during my trip. Will definitely be using them again during my next visit to Rome. Five star experience all the way!

Sophia and Benoit are one of a kind: our Napoleon LOVES coming to their place when we have holidays or commitments where he can't be with us. They're always available (whether it's to look after Napo for a few days or take him for walks) and always try to find a solution to help us when we need a hand with Napo—he absolutely adores them!
Highly recommended!!!

Sophia is the best person with animals, always available for my dog ​​Nina. Nina is so happy and feels loved by Sophia.
Sophia is always available, even in the rain, always comes. I'm very happy and she is a reliable person.
Thank you 🩷 …
Sophie and Benoit are lovely friends who love my two beagles dearly and care for them with empathy and expertise.

I've left my dog ​​with them several times, and each time it's been a super positive experience. You can really see how much they love animals: they're attentive, caring, and always available.

My dog ​​always returned happy, calm, and well-groomed, and that's the most important thing for me. They kept me updated with photos and messages, which made me feel even more at ease while I was away.

The environment is clean, welcoming, and above all, full of attention to our four-legged friends. They've become a go-to for me: I know I can leave with peace of mind.

I absolutely recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy and competent dog sitter ❤️

We couldn’t be happier with the care our dogs receive. They are truly loving, attentive, and incredibly dedicated. From picking them up to bringing them back home, everything is handled with so much care and professionalism.

Leaving our dogs with them feels easy and stress-free because we know they are in the best hands. They are flexible, accommodating, and genuinely devoted to the dogs’ well-being. They play with them, feed them properly, and even sleep with them, making sure they feel safe, comfortable, and loved at all times.

We are so grateful to have found such trustworthy and caring people. Highly recommend.
Sophia (and her boyfriend Benoit) are incredibly kind and helpful. They took care of my beloved Ares several times when I was on vacation, and I had a great time. Highly recommended!

I can't say enough about how incredible Sophia is. She's without a doubt the best dog sitter ever. From the first moment, she exudes a peace, love, and professionalism that make you feel completely at ease leaving your dogs in her care.

Sophia doesn't just care for dogs... she truly loves them. It shows in every detail: in the way she talks to them, in the way she looks at them, in how she makes sure they're comfortable, happy, and safe. She's responsible, attentive, sweet, and extremely dedicated. She's always sending updates, photos, and messages that give you immense peace of mind.

My two dogs adore her, and that says it all for me. They get emotional when they see her and go home happy, calm, and perfectly cared for. There's no greater joy than knowing they're with someone who loves them as if they were her own.

If you're looking for someone trustworthy, affectionate, professional, and with a huge heart, Sophia is simply the best choice. I recommend her wholeheartedly. 💕🐶

Sophia has cared for my cat (my baby!) a few times and is fantastic. I moved to Rome a few months ago with my cat and was very nervous about leaving her behind when I had to go on short trips. I booked Sophia and she was fantastic. My cat is very anxious around strangers, and Sophia was kind and patient; she also always let me know when she was at my house and sent me tons of photos and updates. I've used Sophia every time I've had to travel and will continue to do so: it's so important to have someone reliable to care for your pets when you have to travel, and I'm so happy I found Sophia.

I've known Sophia for a year now, and I couldn't be happier to have chosen her as my cat sitter for my two cats. When I'm away, I can rest easy knowing I'm leaving them in good hands. She's very reliable, attentive, and caring, and she's incredibly sweet with my cats, always keeping me updated with videos and photos. I highly recommend her!
The most beautiful and welcoming place you could wish for your dogs! Sophie and Benoit are a priceless guarantee! Thank you for your passion!

Luigi is always so happy and calm! We've been leaving him with Sophie and Benoit for two years, and it's like leaving him in a second home. They're always precise, attentive, professional, and affectionate.
Highly recommended! Adelaide had a great time and the staff were incredibly helpful! We'll definitely be back!

Simply exceptional dog sitting service. Every time I leave my dog ​​with complete peace of mind and confidence, knowing he's in attentive, loving, and professional hands. When I return, I always find him happy and relaxed. Perfect communication, attention to detail, and a true love for animals: I couldn't ask for anything better. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a reliable and caring service!
I had no other dog-sitting experience, but with Benoit it went super well: my Pepita stayed peacefully. I highly recommend him 😊 …
